author: KEXP
description: Shoegaze legends Chapterhouse celebrate the 25th anniversary of their beloved 1991 debut album 'Whirlpool.' Delivering a hypnotic Live on KEXP session, the band offers a performance of "Pearl" and more from the record.
title: Chapterhouse performs "Pearl " & more Live on KEXP
